Solana Beach City Council, Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency, Public Financing Authority, & Housing Authority
MINUTES
JOINT SPECIAL MEETING
Wednesday, September 10, 2014
06:30 P.M.
City Hall / Council Chambers
Minutes contain a summary of the discussions and actions taken by the City Council during a meeting. City Council meetings are video recorded and archived as a permanent record. The video recordings capture the complete proceedings of the meeting and are available for viewing on the City's website.
CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL:
Mayor Campbell called the meeting to oder at 7:50 pm

Nichols, Campbell, Heebner, Zito, and Zahn.

None.

David Ott, City Manager

D.
STAFF REPORTS: (D.1.)
Submit speaker slips to the City Clerk.
Submit speaker slips to the City Clerk
D.1.
Consideration to Submit a Letter of Support for the Nomination of Del Mar Mayor Lee Haydu to the 22nd District Agricultural Association Board of Directors to the Office of Governor Edmund G. Brown, Jr. (File 0480-75)
David Ott, City Manager, introduced the item.
Deputy Mayor Heebner said that Mayor Haydu had a lot of support from her Council as well as Assembly Speaker Toni Atkins office and Marty Block's office.
Councilmember Nichols said that he supported the letter and pointed out a few typos and references in the letter to correct, that Mayor Haydu lived very close to the Fairgrounds and whether she would have a conflict.
Johanna Canlas, City Attonrey, stated that she would have to review the conflict rules for the Fairgrounds.
MOTION: Moved by Heebner and seconded by Nichols to approve the letter contingent on any issues that arise with the City Attorney's findings of the Fairground's conflict rules.
Motion carried unanimously.
COMMITTEE REPORTS:
ADJOURN:
Mayor Campbell adjourned the meeting at 7:54 p.m.
Angela Ivey, City Clerk Approved: November 12, 2014
